mapper.sql: m.meeting_id,m.meeting_code,m.meeting_code AS asset_code,m.project_id,p.project_name,m.granularity,m.meeting_source,m.meeting_title,m.meeting_content,m.meeting_conclusion,m.business_scenario,m.keywords,(SELECT ma.attachment_id FROM dm_content_attachment ma WHERE ma.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND ma.business_type='MEETING' AND ma.business_id=m.meeting_id AND ma.deleted=0 ORDER BY ma.sort_order,ma.created_at LIMIT 1) AS attachment_id,m.created_by,m.created_at,m.updated_by,m.updated_at,m.deleted_by,m.deleted_at,(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(ms.system_code) FROM dm_meeting_system ms WHERE ms.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND ms.meeting_id=m.meeting_id) AS system_codes,(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(i.issue_name ORDER BY i.issue_name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM dm_issue_relation r JOIN dm_issue i ON i.id=r.issue_id AND i.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND i.deleted=0 WHERE r.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND r.related_type='MEETING' AND r.related_id=m.meeting_id) AS related_issue_names,(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(r.issue_id) FROM dm_issue_relation r WHERE r.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND r.related_type='MEETING' AND r.related_id=m.meeting_id) AS related_issue_ids
FROM dm_meeting m LEFT JOIN pm_project p ON p.id=m.project_id AND p.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND p.deleted=0

WHERE m.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND m.project_id=#{p.projectId} AND m.deleted=#{p.deleted} AND m.meeting_source=#{p.meetingSource} AND m.granularity=#{p.granularity} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dm_meeting_system ms WHERE ms.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND ms.meeting_id=m.meeting_id AND ms.system_code=#{p.systemCode}) AND (m.meeting_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.keyword},'%') OR m.meeting_title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.keyword},'%') OR m.keywords LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.keyword},'%'))
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY m.meeting_code ASC,m.meeting_id ASC LIMIT #{p.limit} OFFSET #{p.offset}
SELECT WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.meeting_id=#{id} AND m.deleted=0
SELECT WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.meeting_id=#{id} AND m.deleted=1
mapper.update: UPDATE dm_meeting SET meeting_code=#{p.code},granularity=#{p.granularity},meeting_source=#{p.meetingSource},meeting_title=#{p.title},meeting_content=#{p.content},meeting_conclusion=#{p.conclusion},business_scenario=#{p.scenario},keywords=#{p.keywords},updated_by=#{p.actorId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE meeting_id=#{p.id} AND tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND deleted=0
UPDATE dm_meeting SET deleted=1,deleted_by=#{actorId},deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE meeting_id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
UPDATE dm_meeting SET deleted=0,deleted_by=NULL,deleted_at=NULL,updated_by=#{actorId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE meeting_id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dm_meeting WHERE meeting_id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
mapper.select: SELECT meeting_id FROM dm_meeting WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND deleted=1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dm_meeting WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND deleted=1

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dm_meeting_system WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND meeting_id=#{id}
DELETE FROM dm_issue_relation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND related_type='MEETING' AND related_id=#{id}
DELETE s FROM dm_meeting_system s JOIN dm_meeting m ON m.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND m.meeting_id=s.meeting_id WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.project_id=#{projectId} AND m.deleted=1

DELETE r FROM dm_issue_relation r JOIN dm_meeting m ON m.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND r.related_type='MEETING' AND r.related_id=m.meeting_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.project_id=#{projectId} AND m.deleted=1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dm_issue WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND deleted=0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dm_meeting WHERE tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND project_id=#{p.projectId} AND meeting_code=#{p.code} AND deleted=0 AND meeting_id <> #{p.excludeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE dm_content_attachment SET deleted=0,deleted_by=NULL,deleted_at=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND business_type='MEETING' AND business_id=#{meetingId} AND attachment_id=#{attachmentId} AND deleted=1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dm_content_attachment a LEFT JOIN dm_meeting m ON m.meeting_id=a.business_id AND m.tenant_id=a.tenant_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND a.business_type='MEETING' AND a.deleted=1 AND m.project_id=#{p.projectId} AND (a.file_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.keyword},'%') OR m.meeting_title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.keyword},'%'))

SELECT a.id,a.attachment_id,a.file_name,a.sort_order,a.business_id AS meeting_id,a.deleted_by,a.deleted_at,m.meeting_title FROM dm_content_attachment a LEFT JOIN dm_meeting m ON m.meeting_id=a.business_id AND m.tenant_id=a.tenant_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND a.business_type='MEETING' AND a.deleted=1 AND m.project_id=#{p.projectId} AND (a.file_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.keyword},'%') OR m.meeting_title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.keyword},'%')) ORDER BY a.deleted_at DESC LIMIT #{p.limit} OFFSET #{p.offset}

SELECT a.id FROM dm_content_attachment a JOIN dm_meeting m ON m.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND m.meeting_id=a.business_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.business_type='MEETING' AND a.deleted=1 AND m.project_id=#{projectId}
SELECT project_id FROM dm_meeting WHERE meeting_id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
